Proprietorship
What is a Proprietorship / Proprietor?

A proprietorship is the simplest and most widely used form of business in India, where the business is owned, managed, and controlled by a single individual known as the proprietor. It has no separate legal existence from its owner, meaning the proprietor and business are treated as one under law.
Registrations are not mandatory for formation, but operational registrations may be required depending on the nature of business.

Pros and Cons

Pros:

Minimal cost and quick setup

Complete decision-making authority

Low compliance burden

Ideal for small traders and freelancers

Cons:

Unlimited personal liability

Limited scalability

Difficulty in raising external funding

Business continuity depends solely on proprietor

Documents Required

Photograph of the proprietor

Business name and nature of business

PAN and Aadhaar of proprietor

Registered office address proof (rent agreement / electricity bill)

Bank account details

Email ID and mobile number

Compliance Requirements

Income Tax Return filing if total income exceeds ₹2.5 lakhs

Tax audit if turnover exceeds prescribed limits

GST registration mandatory if turnover exceeds ₹40 lakhs (₹20 lakhs for services)

Other registrations such as Shop & Establishment, MSME, or Professional Tax as applicable

Partnership / LLP
What is a Partnership / LLP?

A Partnership firm is formed when two or more individuals come together to carry on a business with profit-sharing arrangements governed by a partnership deed. An LLP is a registered legal entity that provides limited liability protection while retaining operational flexibility.

Pros and Cons

Pros:

Shared capital and responsibilities

LLP offers limited liability protection

More credibility than proprietorship

Suitable for professionals and consulting firms

Cons:

Unlimited liability in traditional partnership

Disputes between partners can affect operations

LLP compliance higher than partnership

Documents Required

PAN and Aadhaar of all partners

Address proof of partners

Registered office address proof

Partnership deed / LLP agreement

Digital Signature Certificates (for LLP)

Email ID and contact details

Compliance Requirements

Income Tax Return filing

Tax audit if turnover exceeds limits

LLP annual filing with MCA (Form 8 & Form 11)

GST, Professional Tax, and other registrations as applicable

Private Limited Company
What is a Private Limited Company?

A Private Limited Company is a separate legal entity incorporated under the Companies Act, 2013. It offers limited liability to shareholders and is the most preferred structure for businesses aiming for growth, external investment, and scalability.

Pros and Cons

Pros:

Limited liability for shareholders

Separate legal identity

Easy transfer of ownership

Better access to funding and investors

Cons:

Higher setup and maintenance costs

Mandatory statutory audits

Strict regulatory compliance

Documents Required

PAN, Aadhaar, and address proof of directors

Passport-size photographs

Registered office proof

Digital Signature Certificates (DSC)

Director Identification Number (DIN)

Compliance Requirements

Annual ROC filings (AOC-4, MGT-7)

Statutory audit by Chartered Accountant

Income Tax Return filing

GST, TDS, and other applicable compliances

One Person Company (OPC)
What is a One Person Company?

An OPC allows a single individual to incorporate a company with limited liability and corporate recognition. It bridges the gap between proprietorship and private limited company.

Pros and Cons

Pros:

Limited liability protection

Separate legal identity

Full control with corporate benefits

Cons:

Mandatory conversion upon crossing thresholds

Cannot have more than one member

Higher compliance compared to proprietorship

Documents Required

PAN and Aadhaar of owner

Nominee consent and identity proof

Registered office proof

DSC and DIN

Compliance Requirements

Annual ROC filings

Income Tax Return filing

Mandatory statutory audit

GST registration if applicable

Section 8 Company
What is a Section 8 Company?

A Section 8 Company is formed for charitable and non-profit objectives such as education, social welfare, environmental protection, or arts promotion. Profits are reinvested and cannot be distributed among members.

Pros and Cons

Pros:

High credibility and recognition

Eligibility for tax exemptions

Limited liability protection

Cons:

Strict regulatory oversight

No dividend distribution

Mandatory audits and filings

Documents Required

PAN and Aadhaar of directors

Registered office proof

MOA and AOA

DSC and DIN

Compliance Requirements

Annual ROC filings

Income Tax Return

Statutory audit

Compliance under Income Tax Act and Companies Act

Optional 12A and 80G registrations for tax benefits

Trust / Society
What is a Trust / Society?

Trusts and Societies are legal entities formed for charitable, religious, educational, or social purposes. Trusts are governed by the Indian Trusts Act, while Societies are governed by the Societies Registration Act.

Pros and Cons

Pros:

Suitable for long-term charitable activities

Eligible for grants and donations

Tax exemptions available

Cons:

Limited commercial flexibility

Higher regulatory scrutiny

Management restrictions

Documents Required

Trust deed / Memorandum of Society

PAN of trust/society

Identity and address proof of trustees/members

Registered office proof

Compliance Requirements

Annual Income Tax Return

Audit if income exceeds prescribed limits

Compliance under respective Trust/Society Acts

Registration under 12A & 80G for tax exemptions

Public Limited Company
What is a Public Limited Company?

A Public Limited Company is a corporate entity that can invite public investment and is governed by the Companies Act, 2013. Listed public companies are regulated by SEBI.

Pros and Cons

Pros:

Ability to raise large-scale capital

High transparency and credibility

Easy transfer of shares

Cons:

Extensive regulatory compliance

High operating and disclosure costs

Reduced management flexibility

Documents Required

Director and shareholder KYC documents

Registered office proof

DSC and DIN

MOA and AOA

Compliance Requirements

Annual ROC filings

Statutory and internal audits

SEBI compliances (for listed companies)

Income Tax, GST, and TDS compliances

Funding Advisory
What is Funding Advisory?

Funding advisory services assist businesses in planning, structuring, and executing fund-raising activities including seed funding, angel investments, venture capital, and debt financing.

Pros and Cons

Pros:

Strategic fundraising roadmap

Enhanced investor readiness

Regulatory-compliant capital structuring

Cons:

Professional advisory costs

Extensive disclosure requirements

Documents Required

Business plan and pitch deck

Financial projections and valuation report

Historical financial statements

Corporate and compliance documents

Compliance Requirements

FEMA compliance for foreign investments

ROC filings for share allotments

Valuation as per Income Tax and Companies Act

Ongoing investor and regulatory reporting


Global Services
Overview

Expanding across borders requires strict compliance with foreign exchange laws, trade regulations, and international tax frameworks. We assist businesses in setting up and managing global operations with complete regulatory clarity and financial efficiency.

Scope of Work

Import Export Code (IEC) registration and modifications

FEMA compliance advisory for inbound and outbound transactions

Foreign remittance structuring and reporting (FIRC, SOFTEX, ODI/FDI)

Cross-border taxation advisory and DTAA applicability

Liaison with banks, AD dealers, and regulatory authorities

Advisory on transfer pricing and international structuring (non-litigation)

Target Audience

Exporters, importers, startups expanding overseas, subsidiaries of foreign companies, and businesses with international transactions.

Key Benefits

Smooth onboarding into international trade

Reduced foreign exchange and regulatory risks

Optimized tax position for cross-border transactions

Expert handling of complex FEMA regulations

Compliance Value

Non-compliance with FEMA and international tax laws can result in heavy penalties, blocked remittances, and scrutiny from regulators such as RBI and Income Tax authorities.

Project Consulting
Overview

Strategic financial planning is critical for project success. We support businesses with in-depth financial analysis, funding support, and feasibility assessments to ensure informed decision-making and lender confidence.

Scope of Work

Preparation of CMA data and financial projections

Project feasibility and viability studies

Techno-economic reports for infrastructure and expansion projects

Loan syndication support and lender coordination

Working capital and term loan structuring

Financial modeling and sensitivity analysis

Target Audience

Manufacturing units, infrastructure companies, MSMEs, startups seeking funding, and businesses planning large-scale expansion.

Key Benefits

Improved chances of loan approval

Data-driven investment decisions

Professionally structured financial reports

Stronger credibility with banks and financial institutions

Compliance Value

Improper financial projections or non-standard reporting can lead to loan rejections, funding delays, and increased financial risk during project execution.

Audit & Assurance
Overview

Audits are essential for maintaining financial transparency, regulatory compliance, and stakeholder trust. We deliver independent and systematic audit services tailored to statutory and business requirements.

Scope of Work

Statutory audits under Companies Act and applicable laws

Internal audits for process and control evaluation

Income Tax Audits under Section 44AB

GST audit and reconciliation support

Risk assessment and compliance review

Audit reports and management recommendations

Target Audience

Companies, LLPs, partnerships, trusts, and high-turnover businesses requiring mandatory audits or internal control strengthening.

Key Benefits

Enhanced financial credibility

Early identification of risks and control gaps

Improved compliance posture

Reliable financial reporting for stakeholders

Compliance Value

Failure to conduct mandatory audits or inaccuracies in audit reporting can attract penalties, disallowances, and increased scrutiny from tax and regulatory authorities.

payload.text:
About Us
We are a professionally managed Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) service provider headquartered in Madurai, India, delivering specialised offshore accounting and compliance support services exclusively to Singapore Chartered Accountant firms and Public Accounting Corporations.
Our organisation was established to address the growing need among Singapore accounting practices for a dependable, scalable, and technically competent offshore delivery partner—one that understands not only accounting processes, but also the regulatory, ethical, and professional responsibilities governing public accountants in Singapore.
By combining domain expertise in Singapore accounting and taxation with a structured delivery and quality review framework, we enable our clients to enhance operational efficiency, manage capacity constraints, and optimise costs, without compromising on professional standards, accuracy, or confidentiality.

Team  
Our Professional Team
Our services are executed by a dedicated team of qualified accounting and compliance professionals, supported by robust supervision and quality control mechanisms. The team comprises:
• Chartered Accountants and Cost & Management Accountants with strong technical backgrounds
• Accounting and finance graduates trained in Singapore Financial Reporting Standards (SFRS)
• Audit support executives experienced in working paper preparation and documentation
• Payroll and compliance professionals familiar with CPF, MOM, and IRAS requirements
Each engagement is assigned to a designated team, led by a senior professional who oversees planning, execution, review, and final delivery. This ensures:
• Technical accuracy and consistency
• Adherence to client-specific methodologies and templates
• Compliance with Singapore statutory and professional standards
Continuous training and knowledge updates are conducted to keep our professionals aligned with regulatory changes and best practices in Singapore.









 
Our Services
We provide comprehensive and modular BPO services, allowing Singapore Chartered Accountants to outsource specific processes or entire functions based on their practice needs.
Accounting & Bookkeeping Support
• Day-to-day bookkeeping and ledger maintenance
• Bank, creditor, and debtor reconciliations
• Preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual management accounts
• Trial balance review and mapping
• Year-end financial statement preparation in accordance with SFRS
Audit Support Services
• Audit planning support and documentation
• Preparation of audit working papers and schedules
• Substantive testing, analytical procedures, and sampling support
• Lead schedules and cross-referencing
• Audit file collation and indexing
All audit support services are performed strictly as non-attest support, with final judgement and sign-off retained by the Singapore Public Accountant.
Payroll & Statutory Compliance Support
• Payroll processing support based on client-provided data
• CPF computation, schedules, and reconciliation support
• Leave, overtime, and statutory deduction workings
• Assistance with MOM-related payroll documentation
Tax & Regulatory Support
• Corporate income tax computation support
• Tax schedules and supporting workings
• GST computation and return preparation support
• XBRL preparation, validation, and filing-ready documents
• Regulatory reporting and compliance documentation support
All services are delivered in line with IRAS, ACRA, CPF Board, and MOM requirements, based on information and instructions provided by the client firm.
 
 Home - 
Quality Control & Review Framework
Quality is embedded into every stage of our service delivery through:
• Standard operating procedures (SOPs)
• Maker–checker–reviewer processes
• Senior professional oversight
• Pre-delivery quality checks
• Continuous feedback and improvement mechanisms
This framework ensures that deliverables meet both technical and documentation standards expected by Singapore Chartered Accountants.
 
Confidentiality & Data Security
We maintain strict confidentiality, data protection, and ethical standards consistent with professional practice requirements. Our safeguards include:
• Mandatory confidentiality and non-disclosure agreements for all staff
• Role-based access to client data
• Secure data handling and controlled information flow
• Compliance with professional ethics and client confidentiality obligations
Protecting client and end-customer information is a core principle of our operations.
 
Why Choose Us
• Exclusive focus on serving Singapore Chartered Accountants
• Strong technical understanding of Singapore accounting and compliance framework
• Services delivered and reviewed by qualified professionals
• Cost-efficient offshore model without dilution of quality
• Scalable capacity aligned to peak audit and filing seasons
• Transparent communication and defined accountability
• Long-term partnership mindset rather than transactional outsourcing
 
Our Commitment
We are committed to being a trusted offshore partner to Singapore Chartered Accountants by delivering accurate, compliant, timely, and professionally executed BPO services. Our objective is to support our clients in strengthening their practice, improving efficiency, and sustaining growth, while upholding the highest standards of professionalism and integrity.











































Careers
We believe that our people are the foundation of our service quality and professional credibility. As a growing BPO service provider supporting Singapore Chartered Accountants, we offer a work environment that values professional development, technical excellence, ethical conduct, and long-term career growth.
Why Work With Us
• Exposure to Singapore accounting, audit, tax, payroll, and regulatory frameworks
• Opportunity to work with Public Accounting firms and Chartered Accountants in Singapore
• Structured work processes and professional supervision
• Continuous learning and skill enhancement
• Stable and growth-oriented organisation with long-term vision
Our professionals gain hands-on experience with Singapore Financial Reporting Standards (SFRS), ACRA and IRAS compliance, audit documentation standards, and best practices followed by international accounting firms.
 
Who We Are Looking For
We seek motivated and professionally driven individuals who are keen to build a career in international accounting and compliance services, including:
• Chartered Accountants and Cost & Management Accountants
• CA / CMA Inter-qualified candidates
• Commerce, accounting, and finance graduates
• Professionals with experience in bookkeeping, audit support, payroll, tax, or compliance
• Fresh graduates with strong accounting fundamentals and willingness to learn
Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and commitment to quality are essential.
 
Learning & Development
We invest significantly in the training and development of our team, through:
• Structured onboarding and technical training programmes
• Regular updates on Singapore regulatory and compliance changes
• On-the-job mentoring by senior professionals
• Exposure to real-time client engagements and review processes
Our learning framework is designed to help team members develop both technical competence and professional judgement.
 
Work Culture
We foster a professional, ethical, and collaborative work culture, guided by:
• Integrity and confidentiality
• Accountability and ownership
• Respect for deadlines and quality standards
• Teamwork and open communication
We believe in maintaining a healthy balance between productivity, learning, and personal growth.
 
Career Growth Opportunities
As our organisation expands, we offer clear career progression paths, including opportunities to grow into:
• Senior accounting and audit support roles
• Team lead and review functions
• Engagement management and client coordination roles
• Subject-matter specialist positions
Performance, commitment, and professional attitude are recognised and rewarded.
 
How to Apply
Interested candidates may submit their resume and a brief cover note outlining their qualifications and area of interest. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for further discussions.
